dx_raw:
DIAGNOSIS: Acute ischemic stroke involving the left cerebral hemisphere (likely left middle cerebral artery territory) causing expressive aphasia and right-sided facial droop

Alternatives:
1. Transient ischemic attack (TIA) with persistent post-event dysarthria
2. Spontaneous intracerebral hemorrhage (left basal ganglia/MCA region)
3. Bell's palsy with concurrent functional dysarthria (less likely given the aphasia component)
